description: Read-only YDB scheme list or describe with capped stdout/stderr. It uses the root database for rootDatabase paths and the tenant database otherwise; list supports recursive/long/onePerLine flags, describe supports stats, and incompatible flag combinations are rejected.

action.description: Scheme operation to run. Defaults to list.

configPath.description: Absolute path to an explicit local-ydb config file. Missing, unreadable, oversized, or invalid explicit files fail closed instead of using defaults.

long.description: For action=list, pass -l for detailed object attributes.

maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes returned per stdout/stderr stream. Defaults to 65536.

onePerLine.description: For action=list, pass -1 to print one object per line.

path.description: Scheme path to inspect. Defaults to the configured tenant root.

profile.description: Named profile from local-ydb.config.json. Defaults to config.defaultProfile.

recursive.description: For action=list, pass -R to recursively list subdirectories.

name: local_ydb_scheme
